description.en: OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT OAuth, native settings, and account usage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenAI Codex 模型，支持 ChatGPT 账号登录、原生设置与用量查看，开箱即用。

description.en: dsh-purge 的非官方分支（fork）：适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2、破甲内核 v3
Select text in a DSH reply: a floating toolbar that quotes it into the composer draft or opens a side chat about it.
AI投标灵标书审核 Skill：稳定审核非扫描 PDF/DOCX 的商务标、技术标与通用文档风险
Poppin'Party Live2D 桌宠插件 for DeepSeek Harness (local models, zero external deps)
Startup auto-updater for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): checks the npm registry once on boot and optionally installs newer versions.
DSH 工作完成提示：一轮工作结束播放「冰冰冰」提示音，并在右下角弹出可点击跳转的通知条；声音、音量、提示范围与自定义音源都在设置页里

Union web search for DeepSeek Harness (renamed from dsh-free-search): free keyless engines + many professional paid search APIs — 28 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless; Zhihu glob
Minimalist OpenViking status chip and popover for DeepSeek Harness composer
Bring text-to-video and image-to-video generation to DeepSeek Harness — DashScope Wanx, Volcengine/Doubao Seedance, Google Veo, OpenAI Sora & compatible relays.
浏览器控制插件：把 browser-use / browser-harness 的 Browser Harness 注册为 DSH 会话工具，让 agent 直接写 Python 驱动真实 Chrome（导航/点击/输入/取无障碍树/截图），支持独立专用浏览器与附着系统浏览器两种模式；配置 TypeSafe key 后条件启用 browser_autopilot（Jev 目标式自动化）。
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体直接写 Python 操控真实 Chrome，自动导航、点击、填表、截图，本地运行无需 API Key。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 把一个图/照片变成一套 12 张聊天表情包（表情包风格库 + 贴纸生产工作流 + 确定性后处理，生图依赖 dsh-qw-tool）。
Connect remote dsh web instances through SSH and browse them from the local dsh sidebar.
description.zh: 在一个本地 DSH 网页里就能发现并操作远程 SSH 主机上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，远程工作区随手管。

description.en: Independent two-layer safety gate around the DeepSeek Harness agent loop: deterministic and model-classifier verdicts for prompts, streamed output, tools, and tool results
Session Recap: write session recaps in the background and give the agent bounded progress checkpoints.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: local and remote (SSH) workspaces in one place. Remote execution uses a single SSH connection (multi-hop jumps allowed); bash, files, PTY, and LSP share that link.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 远程管理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，提升操作效率，让开发更顺手。

description.en: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing, diagnostics, migration, and AI integration.
description.zh: 微软官方 .NET/C# AI 编码智能体技能的 fork，额外打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件——覆盖开发、测试、诊断、迁移与 AI 集成。

description.en: DeepSeek API wallet balance in the composer dock with a popover showing topped-up and granted credit, the refresh time, and usage and top-up links, plus a /balance command and an api_balance tool; the Host reads a signed-in account wallet or the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential, so the browser only receives amounts.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻 DeepSeek API 余额胶囊，点开显示充值额度、赠送额度、更新时间与用量/充值链接，另有 /balance 命令与 api_balance 工具；凭据只留在 Host（已登录账户钱包或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY），浏览器只拿到金额。

description.en: Sends an Edge/Windows desktop notification when a tool call waits for approval, and only while the DSH page is in the background or unfocused.
description.zh: 工具调用等待审批时弹出 Edge/Windows 桌面通知，且只在你不在 DSH 页面上（后台或未聚焦）时提醒。

description.en: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with `dsh plugin add`: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你当前正在浏览的 Chrome 标签页，无需视觉能力：页面以带编号元素清单的结构化文本交给模型；点击、输入、按键、滚动、标签页操作与导航都会在扩展侧边栏等你确认，密码与支付卡字段保持掩码。15 个 browser_* 工具覆盖 snapshot、文本读取、标签页列举/打开/跟随、点击、输入、按键、滚动、等待、导航、后退、关闭、前进与刷新。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 桥接插件的再打包版，发布到 npm，可直接 `dsh plugin add` 安装：放宽了宿主安装时校验的 peer 范围，避免被判为版本不兼容；随包的扩展额外探测 DSH 桌面端宿主端口 19387，因此无需手填桥接地址；并附带脚本把扩展复制到固定目录，避免切换 profile 或重装后扩展失效。预构建 Release tarball 内含插件本体与已构建的 MV3 扩展。上游：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser。

description.en: Select a statement in an AI answer, find candidate support in earlier chat and tool records, classify support, and jump to original passages for review.
description.zh: 选中 AI 回答中的一句话，反查此前对话与工具记录中的候选依据，区分直接依据、推论和未找到依据，并跳回原文核对。

description.en: Adds download actions to DSH delivery cards, changed-file review, and the document preview, and hides native open controls that cannot work when the Host is remote or headless. Needs DSH Web; the native open controls are hidden by default and can be restored per browser.
description.zh: 在交付卡片、变更审查和文档预览上增加下载按钮，并隐藏 Host 远程或无桌面时无法生效的原生打开控件。需 DSH Web；原生打开控件默认隐藏，可在浏览器里恢复。

description.en: Adds an appearance settings page to DeepSeek Harness: five eye-comfort light themes, each with its own accent and link colours, plus controls for the accent and background colours, UI and code fonts and sizes, font styles, content width, contrast and reduced motion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加外观设置页：五套护眼浅色主题，每套主题自带匹配的强调色与链接色；另可调整强调色与背景色、界面与代码的字体和字号、字体样式、内容宽度、对比度与减少动态效果。

description.en: A customizable video splash screen plugin for DSH. Replace the default startup with your own local video.
description.zh: 一个为 DSH 打造的自定义视频开屏插件，支持播放你自己的本地视频，完美兼容桌面端。

description.en: Turns an uploaded picture into a floating desk pet by cutting out its background in the page, with idle animation and a live account-balance bubble.
description.zh: 上传一张图片，在页面内抠掉背景做成浮在 Harness 上的桌宠，带呼吸摇摆动画和实时账户余额气泡。

description.en: Windows-only desktop control for DSH with six tools that list windows, capture occluded windows, focus windows, click by coordinate, inject Unicode keyboard input, and diagnose the desktop bridge.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面控制插件，六个工具：列出窗口、抓取被遮挡窗口、聚焦窗口、按坐标点击、注入 Unicode 键盘输入与诊断桌面桥接。

description.en: Registers native doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status Agent tools to automate Doubao Web (doubao.com) via Tabbit Browser, automatically extracting watermark-free 2.7K wm0 original images into local files and multimodal chat attachments.
description.zh: 豆包网页生图 Agent 原生工具插件：向 Agent 注册 doubao_generate_image 与 doubao_image_status 工具，通过 Tabbit 操控 doubao.com 提交生图提示词、选择比例与风格，自动优选 2.7K wm0 无水印超清原图落盘并注入对话附件。

description.en: Exposes the accounts in a local CC Switch database to DeepSeek Harness: every account (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build) becomes a model category in the picker, and the SQLite database is re-read on every model listing and request, so switching accounts in CC Switch needs no DSH restart. Requires CC Switch and the DSH desktop app.
description.zh: 把本地 CC Switch 数据库里的账号接进 DeepSeek Harness：Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Grok Build 的每个账号在模型选择器里各成一类，列模型与发请求时都会重读 SQLite 数据库，在 CC Switch 里换账号不必重启 DSH。需 CC Switch 与 DSH 桌面端。

description.en: Reorder configured models in the composer model picker, set cache-hit, cache-miss and output prices per million tokens, and estimate per-turn and session costs with built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在输入框右下角的模型选择器中自定义模型顺序，按每百万 tokens 设置缓存命中、缓存未命中与输出三档价格，并结合内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价估算逐轮和本会话费用。

description.en: Make the Naiwa desktop pet laugh whenever a DeepSeek Harness agent turn ends. Windows only; requires the Naiwa desktop pet installed.
description.zh: 每轮 DeepSeek Harness 回答结束时，让奶蛙桌宠捧腹大笑一次。仅 Windows；需先安装奶蛙桌宠。

description.en: Renders a TXT novel as a dim text layer behind the DSH chat, with a draggable controller for table of contents, chapter paging, auto-scroll and reading settings.
description.zh: 把 TXT 小说渲染成 DSH 聊天背后的淡色文字层，配一个可拖动的悬浮控件，用于目录、翻章、自动滚动与阅读设置。

description.en: PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page positions, with version and integrity guards. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 在现有右侧文件预览中提供 PDF 内嵌目录导航与本地阅读书签，可添加、改名、删除和跳回页内位置，并有版本与完整性保护。已验证 macOS Apple Silicon 上的 dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Drive Blender 3D modeling from the harness — create primitives, run boolean CSG, transform, assign material and modifier, query the scene, and export STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF via a JSON bridge. Bundles a headless trimesh+manifold3d runtime and a Blender bpy add-on speaking the same protocol. Includes auto environment setup (detect/install/configure/verify via the blender_setup tool).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Blender 3D 建模——创建基本体、布尔运算、变换、赋予材质与修改器、查询场景，并通过 JSON 桥接导出 STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF。内置无头 trimesh+manifold3d 运行时，以及同协议的 Blender bpy 插件。内置自动环境检测/安装/配置/验证（blender_setup 工具）。

description.en: Categorize the plugins installed in a DSH profile into groups (skins, MCP, tools, ...), with per-category batch enable/disable, drag reordering, and automatic skin detection.
description.zh: 把当前 profile 已安装的插件按分类整理（皮肤、MCP、工具……），支持分类批量启停、拖拽排序与皮肤自动识别。

description.en: Confirms a task, searches live community plugin catalogs, reads author documentation, and proposes a minimal plugin plan with saved revisions and a user-confirmed draft for a native DSH conversation.
description.zh: 确认需求、检索动态社区插件目录并阅读作者资料，给出最小插件方案，保存方案版本，再经用户确认把待发送草稿交给 DSH 原生会话。

description.en: Four palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — solid, glass, volume and neon — each with light and dark halves. Neon adds a scene light field with a 46px circuit grid, a laser scan that sweeps the conversation column only while a turn is running, HUD-style workspace labels in the sidebar, embedded MiSans Latin chrome type, and a 125% sidebar type scale that stays fixed while the conversation area zooms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的四套配色：实心 / 玻璃 / 体积 / 霓虹，各含明暗两半。霓虹版在整窗场景光场上叠 46px 电路网格，并在模型运行时让一条激光扫描线扫过对话列（停止即消失）；侧栏工作区名为青色 HUD 标牌，界面拉丁字体内置 MiSans，侧栏字号固定 125% 且不随对话区缩放。

description.en: Windows-only. Trust a newly added workspace folder once, then grants the NTFS rights the workspace-write sandbox needs and pushes the grant plus the Low integrity label through folders that already exist; repairs show live progress.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：新增工作区时授权一次，补齐 workspace-write 沙箱所需的 NTFS 权限，并把授权与 Low 完整性标签铺进已有子目录；修复过程带实时进度与日志。

description.en: Expose control of dsh as MCP server and built-in dsh tools.
description.zh: 将控制 dsh 的能力暴露为 MCP 和内置工具。

description.en: Adds job-role prompts to the DSH composer: type - at the start of the input to pick a role, which becomes a reference chip in the draft and is then injected as a system prompt section on every turn of that conversation, so the instruction keeps applying without showing up in the transcript. Roles are added and edited on a Settings page and stored in ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里用岗位角色约束整个会话：在输入框开头键入 - 选一个角色，它会以引用 chip 的形式落在草稿里，随后作为 system prompt 的一部分在这一会话的每一轮注入，指令持续生效且不会出现在对话记录中。角色在设置页新增和编辑，保存在 ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md。

description.en: Folds the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's global panel list into a single row, with a popover to switch panels.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的全局面板列表收进一行，点击弹出浮层切换面板。

description.en: Collapses the sidebar global-panel rows to a few visible entries and adds a picker for choosing which ones stay, so a long panel list stops squeezing the workspace and session area; rows are hidden only, never unregistered.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的全局面板条目折叠成少量可见行，并提供勾选面板决定留哪几个，条目一多时不再挤压工作区与会话区；只隐藏显示，不注销条目。

description.en: Folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, keeping the current batch expanded; the original header is left untouched.
description.zh: 把原生子代理下拉按使用批次折叠为 历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次 四组，本次始终展开；不改动原版头部。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for the whole harness: billed tokens from every session are rolled up per session and turn (uncached input, cache read, cache write and output) with a peak/off-peak CNY cost estimate, and a "Token 用量" entry above Settings in the sidebar opens the dashboard at /token-stats, in a new tab on the web and in an in-app popup on the Desktop. The page recollects and repaints every 60 seconds while the tab is visible. Usage is read from the same session event stream dsh-token-meter consumes, accepting 0.1.x assistant/chunk and 0.2.x assistant/message and assistant/attempt, and counting an attempt repeated after an llm retry as its own billed call; cold history is seeded once from a persisted rollup file and afterwards only logs whose mtime or size changed are re-parsed. Host half and client half ship in the one package.
description.zh: 整个 Harness 的 Token 用量看板：把全部会话的计费 token（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）按会话与轮次汇总，并给出高峰/低谷的人民币预估费用；侧边栏「Token 用量」入口（在设置上方）打开 /token-stats 看板，Web 端新标签页、桌面端应用内弹窗。标签页可见时每 60 秒自动重新采集并重绘。用量读取的是 dsh-token-meter 消费的同一条会话事件流，兼容 0.1.x 的 assistant/chunk 与 0.2.x 的 assistant/message、assistant/attempt；llm 重试后的再次采样按一次新的计费计入；冷历史只从持久化 rollup 文件播种一次，之后仅对 mtime/size 变化的日志做增量重解析。宿主半与客户端半在同一个包里。

description.en: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话轨迹栏边新增「解读」标签：调用模型分轮次解读工具调用情况；允许自定义提示词。

description.en: Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install only (macOS/Linux); requires Node.js 22.19+, pnpm and Git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 源码安装的更新插件：核对官方 GitHub 发布与 npm 记录，在独立目录构建目标版本并试启动，再由监督进程切换、失败回滚，支持定时检查与每日空闲安装时段。仅支持源码安装（macOS/Linux）；需 Node.js 22.19+、pnpm 与 Git。

description.en: Open dsh web from your phone or another computer through a UUMit account, without running your own server or installing another program: a built-in tunnel client connects to UUMit's hosted tunnel, and a panel in the sidebar handles pairing and who can use it (only you, people you invite by link or phone number, or everyone), with revocation. Requires dsh web on DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 用 UUMit 账号在手机或其他电脑上打开这台电脑的 dsh web，不用自建服务器、不装其他程序：插件内置通道客户端连接 UUMit 托管的通道，侧栏里的面板负责配对和选择谁能用（仅自己、通过邀请链接或手机号授权的人、所有人），可随时撤销。需 dsh web 且 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: VA Studio integration: ten tools that generate short dramas, images, videos, novels and screenplays, and reverse-engineer prompts from images or videos. Requires a running VA Studio backend.
description.zh: 接入 VA Studio：10 个工具，生成短剧、图片、视频、小说与剧本，并从图片或视频反推提示词。需运行中的 VA Studio 后端。

description.en: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters; idle plays a chasing scene.
description.zh: 西游师徒卡通桌面悬浮窗：无边框、透明、置顶。点击切换唐僧/孙悟空/猪八戒/沙僧/白龙马，静止自动播放追逐动画。

description.en: Adds extra working directories to a workspace, each read-write or read-only, from a folder button next to the composer or the `/add-dir`, `/remove-dir` and `/dirs` commands; the model sees them in its runtime context, and `write` and `edit` calls into read-write directories skip the sandbox escalation prompt by default while shell commands still ask.
description.zh: 为工作区添加额外的工作目录，可设为读写或只读，可通过输入框旁的文件夹按钮或 `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs` 命令管理；模型可在运行时上下文中看到这些目录，对读写目录的 `write` 与 `edit` 调用默认免去沙箱提权确认，终端命令仍会询问。
